legend: You are developing the scheduling module for the new operating system. This module takes n$$$n$$$ tasks to be executed and the dependencies between them and then puts them in a certain order for execution.

More formally, there are n$$$n$$$ tasks numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$. You are also given m$$$m$$$ dependencies numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to m$$$m$$$; i$$$i$$$-th of them is described by two numbers — ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$, meaning that the task ai$$$a_i$$$ should be executed before the task bi$$$b_i$$$.

In some cases, there are cyclical dependencies — situations when according to the dependencies given some task t1$$$t_1$$$ should be executed before t2$$$t_2$$$, t2$$$t_2$$$ before t3$$$t_3$$$, ..., and tk−1$$$t_{k-1}$$$ before tk$$$t_k$$$ and tk$$$t_k$$$ before t1$$$t_1$$$. Cyclical dependencies create a problem for scheduling, so you decided to remove some of the given dependencies in such a way that the resulting set does not contain any cyclical ones.
However, you still need to keep at least m/2$$$m/2$$$ original dependencies to preserve some of the original information. You are to write the program performing this task.
input: One line containing the numbers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ (2≤n≤105$$$2 \le n \le 10^5$$$, 1≤m≤3⋅105$$$1 \le m \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$).

m$$$m$$$ further lines, each containing two numbers ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤ai,bi≤n$$$1 \le a_i, b_i \le n$$$, ai≠bi$$$a_i \ne b_i$$$), describing the corresponding dependency between two tasks ai$$$a_i$$$ and bi$$$b_i$$$.
output: The first line should should contain YES in case the desired subset of dependencies exists, and NO otherwise.

In the YES case second line should contain the number k$$$k$$$ of the selected dependencies (please note that k$$$k$$$ should be at least m/2$$$m/2$$$) and the third line should contain k$$$k$$$ numbers — the ids of the selected dependencies. They are numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to m$$$m$$$ in the order given in the input.

legend.ai: 你正在为新的操作系统开发调度模块。该模块接收 n$$$n$$$ 个待执行的任务及它们之间的依赖关系，然后将它们按某种顺序安排执行。
更正式地说，有 n$$$n$$$ 个任务，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$。此外，给定 m$$$m$$$ 条依赖关系，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 m$$$m$$$；其中第 i$$$i$$$ 条依赖关系由两个数表示——ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$，这意味着任务 ai$$$a_i$$$ 应在任务 bi$$$b_i$$$ 之前执行。

在某些情况下，存在循环依赖——根据给定的依赖关系，某个任务 t1$$$t_1$$$ 应在 t2$$$t_2$$$ 之前执行，t2$$$t_2$$$ 应在 t3$$$t_3$$$ 之前执行，……，tk−1$$$t_{k-1}$$$ 应在 tk$$$t_k$$$ 之前执行，并且 tk$$$t_k$$$ 应在 t1$$$t_1$$$ 之前执行。循环依赖会给调度带来问题，因此你决定删除部分给定的依赖关系，使得到的依赖关系集合不包含任何循环依赖。
然而，为了保留部分原始信息，你仍需至少保留 m/2$$$m/2$$$ 条原始依赖关系。请编写程序完成这一任务。

input.ai: 接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行，每行包含两个数字 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$(1≤ai,bi≤n$$$1 \le a_i, b_i \le n$$$，ai≠bi$$$a_i \ne b_i$$$)，描述任务 ai$$$a_i$$$ 和 bi$$$b_i$$$ 之间对应的依赖关系。

output.ai: 如果存在符合要求的依赖关系子集，第一行应包含 YES，否则应包含 NO。
如果答案为 YES，第二行应包含选出的依赖关系数量 k$$$k$$$(注意，k$$$k$$$ 至少应为 m/2$$$m/2$$$)，第三行应包含 k$$$k$$$ 个数字，即选出的依赖关系编号。它们按照输入中的顺序从 1$$$1$$$ 到 m$$$m$$$ 编号。
